Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: premium square application icon for AM Arcade, a browser-based immersive 3D retro arcade.
Primary request: Create a spectacular yet exceptionally readable dimensional arcade cabinet emblem. One compact front-facing arcade cabinet, very slight view from above, with a thick angular silhouette, chamfered upper corners, broad CRT display and a forward projecting control deck. A custom geometric capital A formed from two bright cyan diagonal beams and one hot pink crossbar is displayed on the near-black CRT. Tiny pink joystick and two ivory action buttons on the deck. The cabinet is violet anodized metal with precise luminous cyan edge strips and restrained magenta reflections, substantial clean surfaces and sculpted beveled edges. Base has a single horizontal pink token-slot detail.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat deep midnight violet #090617 square canvas, no external scenery. Cabinet occupies 76 percent of square, centered with generous 12 percent safe margins.
Style/medium: art-directed high-end 3D brand icon, bold graphic silhouette, tactile enamel and machined metal, precise hard-surface modeling, elegant neon lighting, editorial product render.
Color palette: electric cyan #00e5ff, hot pink #ff2bd6, midnight violet #090617, small warm ivory highlights #ffe066.
Constraints: ONE cabinet only. The ONLY text is the simple geometric A emblem, no other letters or words. No surrounding frame, no rounded-square tile, no grid floor, no floating particles, no cables, no watermark, no exaggerated bloom. Crisp silhouette remains legible at 64px. Square 1024x1024 or larger.
